environment.description: CLI tool deployed as a Lambda-backed API Gateway endpoint (REST) that accepts user parameters and forwards them to the internal GraphQL service. The API Gateway has no request validation template, and the internal GraphQL endpoint (running Apollo Server 3.x) is accessible directly from the Lambda's VPC subnet. No WAF is attached to either the API Gateway or the internal ALB fronting the GraphQL service. The GraphQL schema allows introspection and has no query depth limiting or cost analysis enabled.
